evals.prompt: Create a scratch copy of the full woodworking fixture extraction, which already carries one calibration round: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d); cp -r tests/fixtures/extractions/woodworking "$SCRATCH/woodworking". From the repo root, run /metacognition:calibrate woodworking --extractions-root "$SCRATCH" --corrections tests/fixtures/calibration/corrections-round-02.md. The corrections file supplies both scripted redlines, so the round runs end to end without a live chat turn.
evals.expected_output: calibration/round-02.md written at $SCRATCH/woodworking/calibration/round-02.md per the round file format (frontmatter domain, round, date, task, corrections; sections Task, Generated artifact (probe; never ships), Corrections (verbatim), Fold-back decisions); profile.md at $SCRATCH/woodworking/profile.md edited with a `<!-- calibrated: round 2, YYYY-MM-DD -->` marker on every changed line and a restamped frontmatter version; the profile's token_estimate refreshed by `scripts/update_token_estimate.py` (or by the stated by-hand fallback when the script cannot run); the round stays contiguous with the fixture's existing round-01.md; the run ends by naming the files written and the next stage's command.
assertions: the transcript states the extraction root in one line before the round starts
$SCRATCH/woodworking/calibration/round-02.md exists with frontmatter round: 2 and corrections: 2
the round file's four sections appear in order: Task, Generated artifact (probe; never ships), Corrections (verbatim), Fold-back decisions
the Generated artifact section states plainly that the artifact is a probe and never ships
the Fold-back decisions table carries one row per correction with a decision letter and the specific profile edit made
$SCRATCH/woodworking/profile.md carries at least one `<!-- calibrated: round 2,` marker comment
$SCRATCH/woodworking/profile.md's frontmatter version is restamped to today's date in the form profile-format.md prescribes for the version field
$SCRATCH/woodworking/profile.md's calibration_state section reflects two rounds and this round's correction count

after the fold-back edits, the token_estimate line was refreshed by running `python3 scripts/update_token_estimate.py` on profile.md and the value it printed was reported, or the run said the script could not run and used the by-hand fallback it states
the closing self-check, python3 scripts/validate_artifacts.py "$SCRATCH/woodworking" run from the calibrate skill's own directory, exits 0 (round-01.md and round-02.md are contiguous)
the run ends by naming calibration/round-02.md and profile.md as the files written and /metacognition:skillify woodworking as the next stage's command, then stops
